Formal vs informal credit: who lends, who supervises and what it costs, Class 10 Economics, Money and Credit, explained.

• Formal: banks and cooperatives, supervised by the RBI
• Informal: moneylenders, traders, employers, relatives and friends, with no one supervising
• Sonpur: Shyamal pays 5% a month (60% a year) to a moneylender; Arun pays 8.5% a year to a bank after offering land as collateral
• Costly informal credit can push borrowers into a debt trap
